turns.text: Why does an "Unauthorized" error appear when calling an API?

must_contain: Unauthorized means one of three keys was refused: the organisation's client id and client secret, the short access token, or the person's own token
Which one was refused depends on which calls fail: the first call, every call after it, or only calls about one person
The check that separates the causes is to run POST /api/hiecm/gateway/v3/sessions on its own, then send the failing call again at once with the accessToken it returned
notes: NHA QA sample, 30 September 2026: 'Correct but overly exaggerated thereby causing confusion.' Verdict group: generic rather than situational. The rejected answer listed every possible cause at once; the case asks for the one check that tells the causes apart.
